subject: Media Literacy
title: Streaming Kills the Schedule
description: A micro-lesson that makes Streaming Kills the Schedule usable.

hook.text: Netflix mailed DVDs in 1998. By 2013, it was producing its own shows. By 2024, it had 260 million subscribers.

buildup.text: Streaming services replaced scheduled programming with on-demand, personalized content.

discovery.text: Binge-watching changed storytelling itself — shows became 10-hour movies, not episodic entertainment.

twist.text: With hundreds of streaming platforms, media is no longer shared culture — everyone watches something different.

climax.text: We gained choice but lost the shared cultural moments that appointment TV used to provide.

quiz.question: What cultural shift did streaming services cause?
options: Loss of shared cultural experiences from appointment TV
